description: This file provides a comprehensive guide and detailed documentation on how to write, organize, and execute Terraform tests using the Terraform testing framework. It covers test components (test blocks, run blocks, assertions, variables, mock providers), configuration options, best practices, mock provider setup, and example test scenarios for unit and integration testing. It serves as a reference for users to understand how to structure and run tests for Terraform modules and configurations, including advanced features like parallel execution, custom state management, and mocking.
